_meta.note: COE bidding history, Cat A and Cat B premiums. LTA DataMall's COEResult endpoint only ever returns the current + previous bidding exercise — there is no historical range endpoint — so this file has no way to be backfilled with past data. It accumulates going forward, one entry per bidding exercise, via scripts/refresh-coe-history.mjs run on a schedule (see .github/workflows/refresh-data.yml). Backfilled from a user-provided LTA export (2010-01 to 2026-07) on 2026-07-19; continues to build forward via the scheduled refresh script from there.
